entities.name: Skrygix
entities.description: Tall Gateless goblin student at Hearth Fountain Academic, in Liric's honors history class.

entities.name: Liric
entities.description: Her history professor, secretly a Dimir agent on a mission to erase a memory.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild Liric serves as an agent.

events.summary: On the last day of school Skrygix gave Liric a painting of his classroom, which made him laugh.
events.quote: The drawing made Liric laugh, and he promised her he would hang it in his office at school.

events.summary: Liric avoided telling Skrygix where he would go for the summer.
events.quote: he avoided answering her, merely bidding her a fun summer

events.summary: Skrygix did not know her teacher was a Dimir agent on a mission to erase an important memory.
events.quote: She did not know that her teacher was a Dimir agent who was on a mission to erase an important memory from someone special.

relations.quote: Liric is her professor there in her honors history class
her teacher was a Dimir agent
